fields.name: created_at
fields.sql: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

rules: source_release_id and p2_release_id remain distinct exact immutable release identities.
NOT_IDENTIFIABLE requires adjusted_value null and governed non-empty reason_codes.
NOT_IDENTIFIABLE does not fabricate uncertainty bounds or an adjusted numeric value.
factor_effects default to model-conditioned association unless independent causal evidence is bound.
Historical resolution never falls back to current/latest.
component_model_refs preserve governed stable order and exact model identities.
as_of_data_time is the knowledge/data cutoff; published_at is not a substitute.
Twin is a published capability read model, not same-episode World state.

fields.source: M8 authority P4 or P5 assessment scope
M8 authority governed approval state carried by assessment status
M8 role/privacy pseudonymous projection of audit.audit_log.actor_id

rules: Every state transition creates an immutable assessment revision and an audit record.
APPROVED and REJECTED are terminal for that revision; later correction creates a new revision.
Administrator/auditor privilege alone does not imply evaluator approval authority.
diagnostics.reason_codes is the canonical cross-layer reason-code location.
diagnostics carries exact uncertainty_method and uncertainty_level from the adopted attribution spec.
Completed IDENTIFIABLE runs require model_artifact_hash.
model_artifact_uri may be null unless an existing managed-object path is used.
model_artifact_uri must resolve to one sealed ACTIVE non-deleted registry.object_reference.
model_artifact_hash must exactly match registry.object_reference.artifact_sha256.
Historical model resolution never uses current/latest/default aliases.

fields.source: resolved registry.object_reference when uncertainty dataset exists

rules: dataset_uri and optional uncertainty_dataset_uri require sealed ACTIVE non-deleted object references.
dataset_hash must match exact object artifact_sha256.
Profile v1 surface axis is observed SESSION_ORDER within the exact lifecycle segment; extrapolation is forbidden.
world_refs elements are canonical UUID strings in governed stable order.
input_hash is lowercase 64-character SHA-256.
created_at is RFC3339 UTC.

fields.source: M8 authority deterministic human-machine evidence identity
exact World/relation refs carried by evidence set
authority-approved evidence payload without implicit score
M8 authority canonical evidence content hash

rules: Machine evidence never carries instructor origin.
UNAVAILABLE, OUT_OF_DOMAIN and NOT_IDENTIFIABLE never coerce to numeric zero.
Evidence family membership does not authorize a metric formula, threshold, weight or score.

fields.source: M8 role/privacy pseudonymous projection of debrief.annotation.author_id

rules: Annotation content is human evidence and never overwrites machine evidence.
A revision creates a new annotation row; prior body/evidence content is preserved.
body_text is omitted unless both role and annotation visibility authorize projection.
Profile v1 claim_level is REFERENCE_CONDITION_LONGITUDINAL_ESTIMATE.
Out-of-domain/unsupported estimates carry null value; zero is never a substitute.
P1 observed and P2 adjusted products remain separately addressable.
Application/governance DTO only; it is not persisted as a P2 product.
P2 external claims require protected-main M6 Exit GO and all required jobs success.
P3-P6 remain inactive.
Exact joined registry.analysis_release.status must be PUBLISHED.
metric.capability_observation.eligibility_status must be ELIGIBLE.
observed_value_numeric must be finite and non-null.
Joined metric semantic value_kind must be NUMERIC.
knowledge_time_utc is exact release published_at; compute/read time is not a substitute.
Historical resolution never falls back to current/latest.
Application/governance DTO only; not persisted as a P3 product.
P3 external claims require protected-main M7 Exit GO and all required jobs success.
P4-P6 remain inactive.

fields.source: max exact published source P1/P2 release time available to P3

rules: Numeric P3 eligibility requires exact published immutable P2 product status IDENTIFIABLE.
NOT_IDENTIFIABLE remains valid P2 evidence but is excluded from numeric P3 input.
configuration_snapshot_id is exact provenance; longitudinal segmentation uses configuration_key derived from snapshot_hash.
session_order_scope must be ACTIVE and assignment current.
source_release_id and p2_release_id remain distinct immutable identities.
Historical resolution never falls back to current/latest/default.

fields.source: ordered exact input configuration snapshot ids
sorted exact lifecycle event ids bound at segment start

rules: snapshot_type is P3_LONGITUDINAL_SEGMENT and frozen=true.
Profile v1 segments on exact aircraft/configuration_key/reference-condition/capability/semantic/unit/session-order-scope identity.
Exact per-session configuration snapshot ids remain provenance and are not themselves the cross-session segment key.
Any lifecycle event occurring after the first selected session and on/before the last selected session forces a new segment in profile v1.
Observation, episode, independent-aircraft and effective-evidence counts remain distinct.

fields.source: exact P3 training dataset snapshot id
ordered exact P2 training estimate ids
ordered exact P2 validation estimate ids

rules: snapshot_type is P3_MODEL_VALIDATION and frozen=true.
Training and validation estimate identities and episode identities are disjoint.
Profile v1 uses temporal last-point holdout and supports AIRCRAFT subject only.
Stronger intrinsic claim is not supported by profile v1.
score and grade may be non-null only when an exact adopted assessment profile authorizes them.
Unsupported evidence remains explicit and never becomes zero.
Published revisions are historical exact-ID products and are not mutated in place.
Application/governance DTO only; not persisted as a P4/P5 product.
P4/P5 external claims require protected-main M8 Exit GO and all required jobs success.
P6 remains inactive.

fields.source: P4/P5 role/privacy profile pseudonymous subject projection
latest permissible source evidence time at or before as_of_utc

rules: subject_key is the default cross-role identity; actor_id is projected only when the exact role/privacy profile authorizes it.
twin_revision_id is exact; current/latest/default resolution and hidden P3 recomputation are forbidden.
subject_context_id changes when any governed identity/scope/configuration input changes.

fields.source: exact adopted assessment/aggregation profile identity or null

rules: overall_score and grade remain null when no exact adopted aggregation profile authorizes them.
A composition change requires a different composition_id and therefore a new assessment revision.
P5 team result is never copied to an individual P4 product.

fields.source: M8 authority deterministic P5 composition identity
ROLE_MODEL plus exact aircraft/twin/P4 revision bindings keyed by subject_key
exact SCENARIO context artifact when bound
M8 authority canonical composition content hash

rules: Participant bindings are stable-sorted by subject_key before hashing.
Membership, role, aircraft, twin revision, relevant P4 revision or governed context change creates a new composition_id.
Direct participant actor IDs are not part of unrestricted projections.
Application/governance DTO only; not persisted as a P6 product.
P6 external claims require protected-main M9 Exit GO and all required jobs success.
Authority/profile adoption and development projections do not admit P6.

fields.source: M9 authority deterministic counterfactual request identity

rules: Interventions and held-fixed assumptions are explicit and hash-bound.
Association-only models cannot be upgraded to causal claims.
Base products and models use exact identities only.
Default claim level is SCENARIO_PROJECTION_NON_CAUSAL.
A stronger causal claim requires separately adopted causal authority and identifiable intervention evidence.
Projection output never mutates the factual baseline.

fields.source: M9 authority deterministic forecast request identity

rules: forecast_request_id is deterministic over exact source, model, target, horizon, assumptions and as_of_utc.
Forecast origin/horizon cannot be silently shifted by runtime defaults.
Current/latest/default model or source resolution is forbidden.
Forecast result is a projection and never an observed/adjusted/capability/assessment fact.
Numeric projection is invalid when applicability is OUT_OF_DOMAIN, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
threshold_probabilities may be populated only when the exact adopted model profile authorizes them.

fields.source: ordered exact P4/P5 published revision refs
ordered exact P3 model/twin/estimate refs when explicitly required

rules: snapshot_type is P6_INPUT and frozen=true.
Every factual_source_ref is an exact published P4/P5 revision; P3 refs are exact when present.
All inputs must be available by as_of_utc; future and same-outcome leakage are forbidden.
Historical resolution never falls back to current/latest/default.

fields.source: M9 authority deterministic interoperability snapshot identity

rules: External mappings are exact-profile/version and preserve fact-versus-projection class.
Lossy phase conversion, unknown/unversioned profile and source/projection conflation fail closed.
Joint/LVC extends source/entity/relation/plugin vocabularies without creating a second fact model.

fields.source: exact frozen P6 validation dataset snapshot id

rules: P6 reuses capability.capability_model and sealed registry.object_reference; no parallel model registry is created.
Training and validation snapshots are exact, frozen and leakage-disjoint.
A model is projection-eligible only under exact adopted model/applicability/uncertainty profiles.
Historical model resolution never uses current/latest/default aliases.
Recommendation is advisory only; it is never fact, historical truth or an automatic command.
Approval/release does not upgrade source forecast/counterfactual claims.
Direct subject identity is projected only under exact role and scope authorization.

fields.source: M8 authority deterministic team/mission evidence identity
P4/P5 authority approved team/mission evidence family
authority-approved evidence payload without implicit aggregate score
M8 authority canonical evidence content hash

rules: Team evidence remains bound to exact composition.
Missing member evidence stays explicit.
Mission objective outcome and team performance evidence remain separate semantics.
